name: The Godstone
description: A stone pillar in the woods of North Aerona that can heal, reverse aging, or kill, once worshiped by orcs, dwarves and hill giants.

description_citations.text: "Aerona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orcs, dwarves and hill giants warred over control of the Godstone until it was lost to time and the elements.
